medkit.name: Medkit
medkit.description: Restores 40 HP to adjacent or self. Medical skill improves healing.

frag_grenade.name: Frag Grenade
frag_grenade.description: Explosive fragmentation grenade. Damages all units in radius.

smoke_grenade.name: Smoke Grenade
smoke_grenade.description: Deploys smoke cloud blocking line of sight for 3 turns.

stim_pack.name: Stim Pack
stim_pack.description: Grants 4 bonus AP this turn. Self-use only.

breach_charge.name: Breach Charge
breach_charge.description: Destroys walls and doors. Must be placed adjacent.
